summary.name: rebyte.ai
summary.one_liner: Rebyte is a cloud platform for running enterprise AI agents with durable execution, controlled permissions, and run tracing for improvement.
keywords: control what ai agent can do
use_cases: Running long-lived AI agent tasks that keep context across conversations
Setting permission boundaries on what an agent can access
Tracing model steps, tool calls, and costs in production agent runs
Exposing one agent through an API, product, CLI, or Slack
Improving agent instructions and skills from observed production outcomes
summary.what_it_does: Rebyte provides a hosted execution layer for AI agents so teams do not have to build or operate the runtime themselves. Agents can keep context and continue work across conversations, and can be given browsers, files, compute, skills, and apps. Administrators approve which models, skills, MCP servers, tools, and apps an agent may use, and can restrict network access, credentials, execution steps, and spend, with the same policy applied to every run. Each run can be traced at the level of model steps, tool calls, errors, tokens, and cost, and outcomes can be annotated so that production evidence feeds back into instructions, skills, and evaluations.
notable: Durable execution that keeps context across conversations without self-hosting the execution stack
Policy controls for capabilities, network, credentials, execution steps, and spend applied uniformly across runs
Per-run tracing of model steps, tool calls, tokens, and cost with annotation for improvement
Same agent can be served through API, product, CLI, or Slack
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Requires an organization API key to get started
